target: Kingdom Rush Frontiers iPhone App Store full-content build
status: requires inventory of user-supplied owned iOS app resources

features.description: Preserve all campaign and post-campaign stages present in the owned mobile build
Control campaign/elite content and challenge availability without removing normal progression support
Max upgrades by default plus reset-for-custom behavior
Expose hero implementations present in the full mobile build with level/skill controls
Custom enemy/unit selector using entities actually present in the full mobile build
Send all authored waves while preserving boss and special entrance hooks
Suppress normal end-of-stage victory until disabled or instant win is used
High-entity back-pressure/throttling where compatible with the mobile engine
Immediately activate all authored waves, wall-clock timer, per-stage/mode best time
Recycle enemies from path end to path start without life loss/exit rewards while preserving state where possible
